releaseTitle: Repair Lineage Recovery and Blocked-Run Reporting
notes: Allows strict failed-only and repair selection to recover from the latest completed focused run when an older full-baseline directory has been pruned.
Keeps failed+new delta dependent on a completed full baseline and continues to reject canceled, blocked, or incomplete run evidence.
Blocked-before-execution summaries now state that prior failures were not evaluated or cleared instead of reporting zero remaining failures.
